controls.regle: Every deployment to a managed environment passes exclusively through an automated CI/CD pipeline; each run produces an immutable, timestamped log (author, version, target, result).
controls.verification: Inventory the direct deployment access (outside the pipeline) on each managed environment; verify that no recent deployment bypasses the pipeline, and that the execution log is immutable and complete (author, version, target, result).
controls.preuve_attendue: Inventory of deployment access by environment + excerpt of the pipeline execution log over the audit period.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = 0 deployment outside the pipeline observed + complete immutable log ; partial = documented and waived exceptions ; non-compliant = untracked manual deployment observed
actions_audit: Inspect the direct deployment access on each managed environment; attach the access inventory.
Confirm from the pipeline execution log the absence of deployments outside the pipeline over the audit period; document the result.
If a gap is found: revoke the direct deployment access and route every deployment through the pipeline.

controls.regle: All managed infrastructure is described as code (Infrastructure as Code), whose reference state is stored remotely, versioned, and locked, with no out-of-band modification.
controls.verification: Verify the IaC coverage of the managed infrastructure (absence of resources created outside the code), the remote state configuration (locking, versioning), and the execution of drift detection.
controls.preuve_attendue: Remote state configuration + drift detection report + inventory of resources not covered by IaC (if applicable).
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = 0 drift detected + remote state locked and versioned ; partial = isolated drift corrected ; non-compliant = undetected or recurring out-of-band modification
actions_audit: Run or review the latest drift detection report between the declared state and the actual state; attach the report.
Verify the remote state configuration (locking, versioning); document the finding.
If a gap is found: cover the missing resources with IaC and secure the remote state.
standards: CIS Controls v8 — 4 (configuration sécurisée par policy-as-code)

controls.regle: SAST, secrets detection, and vulnerable dependency scans are integrated into the pipeline and run on every integration, as a blocking gate on any critical vulnerability.
controls.verification: Verify the presence of the three scan types (SAST, secrets, dependencies) in the pipeline configuration and the pipeline's blocking behavior on critical detection.
controls.preuve_attendue: Scan gate configuration in the pipeline + scan reports over recent history + evidence of a block on a critical vulnerability.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = 3 scans active and blocking on high criticality ; partial = scans active but not blocking ; non-compliant = absence of at least one scan type
actions_audit: Verify the configuration of the three scans (SAST, secrets, dependencies) in the pipeline; attach the configuration.
Introduce a canary vulnerability in a test environment and confirm the pipeline blocks; document the result.
If a gap is found: integrate the missing scans and activate the blocking behavior.

controls.regle: A progressive deployment strategy (blue-green, canary, or rolling depending on context) is documented and applied, and the promotion of a version from one environment to the next passes exclusively through the pipeline, with a tracked approval at each stage.
controls.verification: Verify the documentation of the chosen deployment strategy (blue-green/canary/rolling) and its effective application; verify that inter-environment promotion can only happen via the pipeline, with a trace of the approval at each stage passed.
controls.preuve_attendue: Deployment strategy documentation + inter-environment promotion approval configuration + log of a recent promotion.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = progressive strategy documented and applied + promotion exclusively via pipeline with tracked approvals ; partial = strategy documented without tracked promotion (or vice versa) ; non-compliant = direct deployment without progressive strategy or traceability
actions_audit: Request the documentation of the chosen progressive deployment strategy; attach the document.
Verify the log of a recent promotion (gates passed, approver, timestamp); document the result.
If a gap is found: document the strategy and track the missing promotion approvals.
standards: DORA (Accelerate) — capacité de livraison continue (déploiement progressif)
SLSA — provenance et reproductibilité du build

controls.regle: Every published artifact (library, service, image) applies a semantic versioning scheme (major.minor.patch), automatically verified in continuous integration, with release notes published for each version.
controls.verification: Verify the configuration of the automatic version scheme check in CI and the systematic publication of release notes for each delivered version.
controls.preuve_attendue: History of published versions + associated release notes + configuration of the automatic scheme verification.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = scheme respected and verified in CI + systematic notes ; partial = scheme respected without automated verification or without systematic notes ; non-compliant = versions not distinguishable or duplicated
actions_audit: Verify the configuration of the automatic version scheme check in CI; attach the configuration.
Confirm the publication of release notes for the latest delivered versions; document the result.
If a gap is found: instrument the automatic verification and systematize the missing release notes.

controls.regle: The repository applies branch protection on the reference branch (prohibition of direct push, required verification statuses) and requires an approved peer review before any merge.
controls.verification: Verify the reference branch protection configuration (merge rules, required statuses, prohibition of direct push) and the number of approvals required before merge.
controls.preuve_attendue: Capture of the branch protection configuration + pull request history showing the absence of direct pushes to the protected branch.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = active protection + mandatory review + no direct push observed ; partial = active protection without mandatory review ; non-compliant = reference branch not protected
actions_audit: Verify the reference branch protection configuration (settings, required approvals); attach the capture.
Confirm from the history the absence of direct pushes to the protected branch; document the result.
If a gap is found: activate the missing branch protection and review requirement.
standards: CIS Controls v8 — 16 (sécurité du logiciel applicatif)

controls.regle: A rollback strategy is defined, tooled by the pipeline, and tested periodically at a defined frequency, without direct manual intervention on the target.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of a rollback mechanism triggerable from the pipeline and the trace of the last rollback exercise (date, result, measured restoration time).
controls.preuve_attendue: Report of the latest rollback exercise + measured restoration time + configuration of the trigger from the pipeline.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = rollback tooled, exercised at the defined frequency, restoration time objective met ; partial = rollback exercised but objective exceeded or frequency not respected ; non-compliant = no rollback exercise observed
actions_audit: Request the report of the latest rollback exercise and the measured restoration time; attach the report.
Verify that triggering the rollback requires no direct manual intervention on the target; document the result.
If a gap is found: tool the rollback from the pipeline and schedule the missing periodic exercise.
